description: The bar chart illustrates the distribution of self-reflection SFT data counts across several reasoning categories. The category axis is the horizontal axis, showing six labeled categories in left-to-right order: Mathematical Reasoning, General Reasoning, Natural Scene Reasoning, Physical Reasoning, Logical Puzzle Reasoning, and Chemical Reasoning; the category labels are angled for readability. The value axis is the vertical axis labeled “Number of Samples,” displayed on a logarithmic scale with major tick labels at approximately \(10^2\), \(10^3\), and \(10^4\), spanning roughly from the tens up to ten-thousands. Each category is represented by a single light-blue vertical bar with a numeric annotation above it: Mathematical Reasoning is labeled 7025, General Reasoning 1709, Natural Scene Reasoning 413, Physical Reasoning 232, Logical Puzzle Reasoning 91, and Chemical Reasoning 49. The bars appear ordered in descending count from left to right, and there is no legend or additional visual emphasis beyond the value labels above the bars.
